_about: The look of the game's sprites (tuned against them: python -m wbrender.render, its compare.png and report.json). look: the Blender scene's (blender/wbsprite.py DEFAULTS); fringe: the colour a land sprite's edges are smoothed against; threshold: how much of a pixel the model must cover to be drawn; water: the partly submerged look of a unit on water.
